source: Wholly synthetic. Written for this repo as the bundling fixture; not a real posting, not based on one.
defends: Rule 4's verdict clause: two labour markets bundled AND a rate that prices only one of them means does_not_make_sense. Erosion-verified -- remove that clause from rule 4 and all three votes flip to makes_sense_with_edits.
practitioner_read: n/a - synthetic. Replaces a real req that was too distinctive to publish even anonymised.
verdict_basis: Two labour markets bundled and the posted salary prices only one of them.
notes: Deliberately contains no recruiter covering note, no residency clause and no unusual stack combination -- nothing that could fingerprint a real employer. The two markets are far apart on purpose: if the merge test ever collapses these, it has stopped working entirely.
does_not_defend: Rule 1's merge/delete/capacity machinery. Erosion-verified the other way: strip those tests and this fixture still passes, because HL7/FHIR interop versus clinical NLP is obvious enough that any model splits it. The machinery is defended by oem_enablement_program_lead (capacity beats adjacency) and healthinsurer_ai_governance_lead (a market hidden in a late section).
